d.ko: Sentenced for a crime you didn't commit, you're cast out of your utopian home and exiled to the destitute steampunk districts below. As you seek to clear name in this otome visual novel, you'll learn about love, encounter handsome allies in low places, and confront the stigma both societies hold.

d.zh:
大洪水將這個世界一分為二。
在空中美麗的烏托邦，「上界」。以及污穢的的機械都市，「下界」。
出生成長於上界的主人公——琪絲，她對下界毫無好感。
當琪絲第一次接觸到那未知的世界時，
命運的齒輪就開始運轉……
